FAQ

Common questions about OpenClaw setup

Do I need technical skills?

No. We handle all the technical setup. You get a simple dashboard to monitor and approve agent work.

What if an agent makes a mistake?

All agents have human approval workflows. Nothing goes public without your review.

How long does setup take?

1 week from discovery call to go-live. Most clients are up and running in 5-7 days.

Can I customize the agents?

Absolutely. We tune each agent to your brand voice, industry, and specific workflows.
